# sitelo

> Zero-config static site generation powered by Vite. Pages are JavaScript/TypeScript functions that return HTML — no framework, no components, no client runtime unless you add it.

Docs: https://sitelo.dev/docs
GitHub: https://github.com/paul-browne/sitelo
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/sitelo

## Install

```bash
npm install -D sitelo
```

Requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+. Vite is bundled.

Optional peers (install only when you enable the feature):

```bash
npm install -D sharp      # images: true
npm install -D pagefind   # pagefind: true
```

## Commands

- `sitelo` — dev server (pages render on request; includes a small dev toolbar)
- `sitelo build` — write static site to `dist/`
- `sitelo preview` — preview the production build

Optional config: `sitelo.config.js` (or `.mjs`). Vite options go under the `vite` key.
Set `devToolbar: false` to hide the dev-only toolbar.

## Mental model

Pages are modules that export a default function (or string) returning HTML. File-based routing under `src/` (configurable via `pagesDir`).

Page extensions: `.ht.js`, `.html.js`, `.ht.ts`, `.html.ts`, `.ht.jsx`, `.html.jsx`, `.ht.tsx`, `.html.tsx`

Examples:

- `src/index.ht.js` → `/`
- `src/about.ht.js` → `/about`
- `src/blog/[slug].ht.js` → `/blog/:slug` (needs `generateStaticParams` at build time)
- `src/docs/[...path].ht.js` → catch-all
- `src/docs/[...path]?.ht.js` → optional catch-all
- `src/(admin)/users.ht.js` → `/users` (route group, segment omitted)

## Page module API

```js
export async function data(ctx) { /* build-time / per-request in dev */ }
export function generateStaticParams() { return [{ slug: 'hello' }] }
export default function render(ctx) { return `<html>…</html>` }
```

`ctx` includes `{ params, data, dev, … }`. Prefer template literals, [javascript-to-html](https://ht.js.org) (recommended), or JSX/TSX.

Import helpers from `sitelo` (e.g. `fetchWithCache`) and `sitelo/page` for typed helpers.

## Local JSON data

Content kept in the repo as JSON is read with `sitelo/data` — no API needed:

```js
import { readJson, readJsonCollection } from 'sitelo/data'

const posts = await readJsonCollection('data/posts', { sort: '-date' })
const site = await readJson('data/site.json')
```

- `readJsonCollection` takes a directory of `.json` files (slug from the filename) or one file holding an array of entries or an object keyed by slug
- Options: `slug`, `sort` (`'date'` / `'-date'` / compare fn), `recursive`, `root`, `cache`
- Relative paths resolve from the project root; reads are memoized per file, and the dev server reloads when a JSON file a page read changes
- See https://sitelo.dev/docs/data

## javascript-to-html (ht.js)

Recommended for writing HTML in JavaScript without a templating engine or React.
Docs: https://ht.js.org — `import { html, head, body, h1 } from 'javascript-to-html'`

## Components (sitelo-ui)

Component library shipped with sitelo, at the `sitelo/ui` entry point. Components are functions returning HTML strings — same model as pages, no framework.

- `import * as ui from 'sitelo/ui'` (recommended: `button`, `input`, `table`, `link`, `code`, `select`, `progress` collide with javascript-to-html element names)
- `styles()` in `head()` links one hashed stylesheet (`/su/ui-<hash>.css`) that sitelo serves in dev and writes into the build — nothing to copy. `{ inline: true }` puts it in a `<style>` instead (~11 kB gzipped per page); `stylesUrl()` is the href alone, `stylesheet()` the raw CSS
- `pruneCss: true` in `sitelo.config.js` cuts the sheet down to the rules the built pages can match; `pruneCss: { keep: ['su-card', 'su-btn*'] }` keeps classes that only arrive at request time
- `theme(tokens, { selector, dark })` overrides CSS custom properties — camelCase keys (`radiusMd` → `--su-radius-md`), palette objects (`{ primary: { base, hover, fg } }`) or literal `--custom` keys — and goes after `styles()`. Dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme` unless `data-theme` / `data-su-theme` is set
- `styles({ preset: 'neumorphism' })` links a preset sheet straight after the core one, restyling every component at once (`neumorphism`: soft UI, raised and inset shadows, text kept at WCAG AA; `glassmorphism`: frosted translucent panes over a bloomed ground, text measured against the brightest colour a pane can sit over); `theme()` still applies on top, and each preset adds a `glow` slot to each palette. The page background must be `var(--su-bg)` for `neumorphism` and `var(--su-glass-ground)` for `glassmorphism`
- `themeScript()` is a blocking inline script that applies a stored theme choice before first paint (needed with `themeToggle()`)
- No client bundle to add: the few components that want a script (dismissible alert, menu outside-click/Escape, theme toggle) import their own sub-kilobyte module from an event attribute, fetched on first interaction and copied into the build only when a page references it. The `uiClient: { base }` config option moves where those are served from
- `sitelo/ui/client` is for driving components from your own code: `toast()`, `setProgress()`, `setSlider()`, `setSlide()`, `setStep()`, `setBadge()`, `setPressed()`, `setTheme()` / `getTheme()` / `toggleTheme()`
- Modals and drawers are `popover` elements, accordions and menus are `<details>`, tabs with panels are a radio group, tooltips are CSS
- Components: `container` `stack` `grid` `divider` `aspectRatio` `card` `cardHeader` `cardTitle` `cardSubtitle` `cardMedia` `cardBody` `cardFooter` `text` `heading` `link` `code` `kbd` `visuallyHidden` `prose` `button` `iconButton` `buttonGroup` `field` `input` `textarea` `select` `slider` `textField` `textareaField` `selectField` `sliderField` `checkbox` `radio` `toggle` `toggleButton` `toggleGroup` `choiceGroup` `avatar` `avatarGroup` `badge` `chip` `tooltip` `table` `list` `listItem` `figure` `carousel` `alert` `empty` `progress` `skeleton` `toasts` `breadcrumbs` `pagination` `tabs` `appBar` `appBarNav` `appBarSpacer` `appBarActions` `navLink` `themeToggle` `modal` `drawer` `closeButton` `menu` `menuItem` `menuSeparator` `accordion` `accordionItem` `collapsible` `hero` `footer` `siteFooter` `footerColumn` `footerBottom` `stat` `statGroup` `steps` `timeline` `timelineItem` `mockup`
- Icons: `icon(name, { label, size, spin, filled })` returns an inline `<svg>` from 99 glyphs drawn in `currentColor` — decorative unless given a `label`. `iconNames()`, `hasIcon()` and `fillableIcons()` list them; `registerIcons({ logo: '<path …/>' })` adds or overrides one. A spinner is `icon('spinner', { spin: true })`
- Aliases for the names that collide with javascript-to-html: `textLink` `dataTable` `textInput` `inlineCode` `selectField` `progressBar` `siteFooter`. The switch is `toggle`; `toggleButton` is a separate pressed-state button.
- Props: an optional props object then children; unknown props pass through to the element as attributes
- Children render as HTML (that is how components nest). For a code sample containing tags use `code({ text: '<h1>Hi</h1>' })`, which escapes; passing children leaves markup intact, for pre-highlighted output
- Extras with a sheet of their own live at `sitelo/ui-extras`: `grain()`, with `grainStyles()` in `head()` beside `styles()`
- See https://sitelo.dev/docs/ui for the guide, https://sitelo.dev/ui for the component gallery — one page per component, every example rendered live — and https://sitelo.dev/ui/theming for tokens, dark mode and presets

## Assets

- Reference `/styles.css` or `/app.js` from HTML → bundled into `dist/`
- Unreferenced code under `src/` is server-only and is not emitted
- `public/` is copied as-is (Vite convention)
- Broken script/stylesheet links fail the build by default

## Generated extras

- `404.html` from `src/404.ht.js` or a default
- `sitemap.xml` when `site` is set in config
- `rss.xml` when `rss` is configured
- Pagefind search index (`dist/pagefind/`) when `pagefind: true` (or an options object) is set; requires `npm install -D pagefind`. By default also synced to `public/pagefind/` for `sitelo` / `sitelo preview`. Mark content with `data-pagefind-body`.
- Image optimization when `images: true` (or an options object) is set; requires `npm install -D sharp`. See https://sitelo.dev/docs/images

## Server islands

- `island(name, props, fallback)` from `sitelo/islands` embeds a placeholder
- Fragment modules live in `src/islands/<name>.js` (not `.ht.js`)
- Client: `mountIslands()` from `sitelo/islands/client`
- Host: `createIslandsHandler` / `createIslandsNodeHandler` / `createIslandsFromDirectory` from `sitelo/islands/server`
- Dev + preview: `sitelo` / `sitelo preview` serve `/_sitelo/islands/<name>` automatically
- Production: Node host, or Netlify/Vercel stubs in https://sitelo.dev/examples/islands

## Deploy

Static site = publish `dist/`. Example host configs: https://sitelo.dev/examples/basic

## Examples

- Basic + deploy configs: https://sitelo.dev/examples/basic
- Local JSON files as data: https://sitelo.dev/examples/json
- WordPress REST API: https://sitelo.dev/examples/wordpress
- Server islands: https://sitelo.dev/examples/islands

## AI guidance

sitelo is not React, Next, Astro, or Hugo. Do not invent a component framework, `_app` layout system, or hydration model. Prefer functions that return HTML strings. For UI components, use `sitelo/ui` rather than reaching for a React component library — its components are also plain functions returning HTML. Point agents at https://sitelo.dev/llms.txt and https://sitelo.dev/docs.
